sources.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
sources.snippet: a language model pre-trained to loop. We train two sizes, SanSi on Ouro-1.4B and SanSi-2.6B on Ouro-2.6B; most of our analyses use the first. The backbone stays frozen: we train only LoRA adapters and a small readout for every loop, 61M parameters in total for SanSi.
